lines.trans: Hello Gabriel, look at my new dress!
Thank you! It is a gorgeous dress.
I have a photo session next door.
I just wanted to say hello.
That is very kind of you.
You can wait for her in her office.
All right, I am going to wait for her a bit.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.

examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

quelle heure est-il? = what time is it?
à tout à l'heure = see you later

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà
merci beaucoup = thank you very much

before the noun; nouvel before a vowel

meanings.en: un peu = a little, a bit

examples.text: Si Kadropov sort avec une belle femme comme toi, il le dit à tout le monde!
